title: sys1-eval: Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
description: Evaluation cases, raw model outputs and analysis code for a paired evaluation of two System-1 decision models (Laya, open weights; Jev, hosted API) on 11 decision points of an LLM agent harness: model routing, tool selection, tool-call guardrails, RAG relevance gating, prompt-injection screening, groundedness, pre-execution safety and PII egress. Includes 7,283 base cases, 6,640 robustness variants, three control experiments, and a single analysis script that regenerates every number and figure. Code: MIT. Annotations and outputs: CC BY 4.0. Evaluation cases embed text from third-party datasets that keep their original licenses (see DATA_LICENSE.md).
